decisions.rationale: Use one launch contract that works on every declared OS. Prefer a cross-platform form: python3 on macOS and Linux, py -3 on Windows, or the documented equivalent. Give explicit remediation steps for macOS, Linux, PowerShell, cmd and Git Bash, keeping one canonical test command. Verify the published commands on the host OS, and record the other OSes as documentation-verified where they cannot be run here.
Remove environment-variables-and-secrets#o3 from lab.json, because secret rotation is not practised. Keep the .env work as supporting practice. No new scope.

No learner pilot is possible in this branch. Label 18 minutes as an estimate in the learner README and in lab.json notes if the schema allows. Keep the 20-minute cap, and record a learner timing pilot as an open item in course-review.md.
Make the opening neutral ('decide whether the claims are supported') and defer the request-changes wording until after step 4.
Reset and cleanup restore the whole starter repository to shipped bytes, with a containment check before removing and recreating. Add a regression test with an arbitrary nested learner file.
Setup sets a repository-local core.excludesFile to an empty file inside .git, leaving global config untouched. Add a test with a global excludes file containing .env.
